summary: Nauticus Robotics filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, reporting receipt of two executed waivers from a holder of its Series B and Series C Convertible Preferred Stock on September 30, 2026. Section 5(a)(xv) would otherwise trigger a default when shares remained outstanding past September 30, 2026. The holder waived the triggering event through March 31, 2027, including the 18% default dividend rate, incremental dividends, and the 125% Triggering Event Conversion multiplier. The waivers do not alter the existing 120% Conversion Amount or ordinary conversion rights. This is a routine material agreement disclosure, not a special situation.
